newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Shell proposes Ecuador oil venture.
newsitem.headline: Shell proposes Ecuador oil venture.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch oil giant Royal Dutch Shell has proposed a series of joint ventures with Ecuador's state-owned Petroecuador, Shell said Thursday.

Shell suggested the two companies jointly set up teams to analyze possible development of oil deposits in the Ecuadorean Amazon, including the Sacha and Libertador fields, the firm announced in a communique.
"In the case of the studies confirming the possibilities of success, Shell would participate in the tender which (Petroecuador) would call for the improved exploitation of those areas," Shell said.
Shell is also interested in other joint ventures with Petroecuador to develop other fields and study Ecuador's oil producing potential.
